critical_code_review_comments: Auth.jsx form submit via Playwright's click on [data-testid=auth-submit] intermittently navigated to '/' WITHOUT dispatching POST /api/auth/login (no request captured in page.on('response')). Filled inputs got cleared on re-render, then /api/auth/me 401 → bounce to /login. Direct API login (context.request.post) always works and sets access_token+refresh_token cookies. Suggest verifying that submit handler is bound before button becomes clickable (busy state race) OR add explicit `onClick` on the submit button as a belt-and-suspenders. Not blocking (API auth path works), but automated E2E flows are impacted.
connectors_catalog.py at 433 lines is fine, but _probe() has a long if/elif chain per auth method; consider dispatch dict for readability. Timeouts (15s) are reasonable.
risk_engine.py at 789 lines — carried over from iter45/46, still worth splitting ledger/export + connector dispatch.
OnboardingTour (data-testid=onboarding-tour, z-9997) continues to intercept clicks on first login for a user — Playwright must remove it. Same UX quirk flagged in iter46.

ledger-export-csv/pdf use window.open with cookies; SameSite=Lax cookies are sent on top-level navigation so this works, but consider using a signed one-time export URL or a hidden download link with rel='noopener' for defence-in-depth (minor).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright login gotcha: page.click('[data-testid=auth-submit]') intermittently navigates to '/' WITHOUT firing POST /api/auth/login (form re-mount race). Reliable workaround: call ctx.request.post('/api/auth/login', ...) to set the access_token/refresh_token cookies, then page.goto('/app/…'). OnboardingTour still needs to be removed via evaluate(). Ledger export buttons on /app/remediations: ledger-export-csv, ledger-export-pdf → /api/risk-engine/ledger/export?format=csv|pdf|json (JSON also supported). Stripe is the only provider that auto-connects in this env (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY). All 35 other providers should report credentials_required until real creds are provided — this is the required No-Mock behavior, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only a testing-flow observation: automated Playwright submit-click on Auth.jsx occasionally races the form re-render and skips the POST. Verified by monitoring page.on('response') — no /api/auth/login request emitted, only /api/auth/me 401s. Direct API auth via context.request.post is fully functional and unblocks all frontend testing.
